methods.label: Multiply the required coordinate
methods.explanation: Scalar multiplication multiplies each coordinate by 3. The y-coordinate is \(3×(−2)=−6\).
methods.levelReason: Uses componentwise scalar multiplication and the elementary sign rule for multiplication.
